summary: Serialize one validated extended EQDSK mapping.

capability: Serialize one validated extended EQDSK mapping back to text.
operation: Serialize extended EQDSK records to text
validated dictionary/class state -> extended EQDSK text
discovery.model: Extended EQDSK text dialect with fixed-width record blocks and a declared grid-origin convention.
discovery.geometry: nnr by nnz grid reconstructed as R = linspace(0, rbox) and Z = linspace(-zbox/2, zbox/2); R/Z values follow the dialect convention with units and COCOS unspecified.
discovery.boundary: Strict mode rejects trailing records; non-strict mode permits trailing records after the complete declared sections.

identity.relation: Deterministic text serialization/deserialization of extended EQDSK records
identity.direction: extended EQDSK text and validated dictionary/class state
identity.definition: 48-character title, four integer fields, four 5-value scalar records, five profiles, C-order psi grid, q profile and fixed-width limiter/vessel coordinate pairs Optional supplied R/Z or r_origin/z_origin must match the dialect fixed origin; otherwise writing raises before destination truncation.
identity.model: Extended EQDSK text dialect with fixed-width record blocks and the declared grid-origin convention.
identity.geometry: nnr by nnz grid reconstructed as R linspace(0,rbox) and Z linspace(-zbox/2,zbox/2)
identity.coordinates: R/Z coordinate values in the dialect's convention; units and COCOS unspecified
identity.boundary: Strict mode rejects trailing records; non-strict permits trailing records after complete declared sections
assumptions: Finite real values and fixed-width coordinate fields
This is not standard EFIT gEQDSK

inputs.name: data
inputs.dtype: finite real arrays and exact integer fields

inputs.name: filename
inputs.constraints: Writable filesystem path; the writer validates before truncating an existing file.

supported: The explicit raw-contour workflow is a separate writer; this dictionary writer remains a deterministic record serializer.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: KeyError when data omits a required record key; EQDSKFormatError for invalid shapes, non-finite values, unrepresentable fields, or fixed-origin conflicts.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: OSError from filesystem access propagates; validation errors occur before destination truncation.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial file is written; validation errors occur before destination truncation.

example.description: Serialize a minimal caller-supplied extended EQDSK mapping and inspect its fixed-width header.
example.code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import numpy as np
from scirel.io.eqdsk import write_eqdsk
mapping = dict(title='EXAMPLE', cursign=1, nnr=2, nnz=2, nnv=2, rbox=1., zbox=2., psi_lim=1., Ip=0., psi=np.zeros((2,2)), nlim_pairs=0, nves_pairs=0, lim_pairs=np.empty((0,2)), ves_pairs=np.empty((0,2)))
for key in ('tor_flux','p_flux','rbphi_flux','pprime_flux','q_flux'):
    mapping[key] = np.zeros(2)
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory)/'example.eqdsk'
    write_eqdsk(mapping, path)
    assert path.read_text().splitlines()[0] == 'EXAMPLE'.ljust(48)+'   1   2   2   2'
example.expected: The first line contains the title and the four declared header integers; the remaining fixed-width arrays are written.

scope: Roundtrip, lexical fixed-width, malformed input and class-state tests
Nonzero-origin rejection, unchanged destination on failure, opaque scalar preservation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Structural IO boundary only; no physical interpretation is claimed.
known_limitations: This dialect cannot represent arbitrary radial or axial origins; attach solver axes to detect loss before writing.

references: L. L. Lao, G EQDSK FORMAT, 7 February 1997, EFIT format specification.
